delete.title: Delete service {name}?
delete.body: The service {service} and its settings will be removed. This cannot be undone; the service’s program files are kept.
delete.running: The service has not stopped yet; Windows removes it once it stops.
delete.system: The service runs a program in the Windows folder and may belong to Windows. Deleting it can break related features or even keep Windows from starting.
delete.pending: Service {name} is marked for deletion. Windows removes it once it stops and no other program is using it.

error.accessDenied: Access denied: service {name} could not be deleted. Turn on the privileged service in Settings, or run Argus as administrator; protected services may still be out of reach.
error.notFound: Service {name} does not exist; it may have been deleted already.
error.serviceOutdated: Access denied: service {name} could not be deleted. The privileged service version is incompatible; update the service and try again.

manageHint: Most services can only be managed with the privileged service enabled or with Argus running as administrator.
